title: Status Saver - Download Status
summary: Status Saver can Save Status Videos & Images. Downloader & Repost
description:
Status Saver is a fast and easy status downloader app that helps you download video status, photo status, and stories from your contacts. With this status saver app, you can save any status instantly, keep it in your gallery, and watch or share it later. It works as a complete video status saver, image status saver, and story downloader in one simple tool.

Save and Share Status in Seconds
This status saver gives you a simple way to save multiple video statuses, photo statuses, and story updates with one tap. You can share downloaded content with friends, repost stories, or keep them offline in your gallery.

Video & Photo Status Downloader
The app provides separate tabs for video status and photo status. You can preview before saving with the built-in image viewer and video player. Whether it’s short clips, photos, or GIFs, this status downloader saves everything quickly.

Main Features
✔ One-tap to download status videos and photos
✔ Separate tabs for video statuses and image statuses
✔ Built-in video player and photo viewer
✔ Repost or share saved statuses instantly
✔ Save unlimited status updates from your contacts
✔ Delete saved items you no longer need

How to Use Status Saver – Status Downloader

- Open the app to view available statuses
- Tap on any video status or photo status you want to save
- Click the download button to store it in your gallery
- Repost, share, or watch saved status stories offline

Why Choose This Status Saver App

- Simple and fast video status downloader
- Reliable photo status saver for images and GIFs
- Save and organize statuses directly in your phone gallery
- Repost and share stories anytime without asking again
- Access all saved statuses offline whenever you want

Disclaimer
This Status Saver - Status Downloader is an independent app and not affiliated with any platform. Please respect copyright and get permission from the content owner before saving, sharing, or reposting any media.
